A little note from us

Read the note

Our love story

One conference, one unexpected connection, a lifetime of adventures

These days, some love stories begin with a swipe. Ours began with the biology of color.

We met at a conference in Portugal in 2022. Marcela was a PhD student on the organizing committee, and Erik was a master's student attending the event. We spent time together every day from the very first day, and by the closing ceremony it was already pretty clear we were in trouble. 😂

Our first kiss happened in Erik's hotel room in Vila do Conde, and after that Marcela practically moved in until he left. We simply got stuck with each other from day one.

Erik came back to Portugal in 2023, and soon after, Marcela visited him in the United States. Spending about a month together, sharing the everyday moments of life as a real couple, made Erik realize she was the one. He gave Marcela a promise ring, something to hold onto when they were oceans apart.

Between the US, Portugal and Brazil, we found ways to see each other more often, and the distance became just another part of the adventure.

In 2024, Erik decided it was time to make his promise official. The plan? A romantic proposal on a Caribbean island in Puerto Rico, reachable only by boat. The weather? A storm. Erik's solution? Find a captain willing to brave it anyway. 😂 After a wild boat ride we reached the island, and Marcela said yes in our own little corner of the Caribbean. A little adventure, a little chaos and a whole lot of love, which is very much us.

We celebrated our wedding in Portugal in 2025, and now it's time for Chapter II: Brazil! Rio de Janeiro is Marcela's hometown, and sharing a piece of her world with everyone we love means everything to us. We're bringing together family and friends from Portugal, the United States, Brazil and beyond for a celebration on the Brazilian coast.

So pack your bags, get your passports ready, and join us in Rio for the next chapter of our story. We can't wait to celebrate with you! 🤍

A little note on colors

To keep our wedding palette special, please avoid white, ivory, off-white, beige and similar shades, as well as aqua and turquoise green, which are reserved for our wedding party.

Thank you for helping us make the day feel extra special. 🤍

Stay & travel

Where to sleep and what to bring

Our main recommendation

Atlântico Sul Hotel

The closest hotel to our venue, and the easiest choice for the big day.

Book on Booking.com Hotel website
Feeling adventurous?

Forest cabins

There are lovely places to stay in the Atlantic Forest around Barra de Guaratiba, close to the after-party.

Browse on Airbnb

Book early

Rio de Janeiro is a host city for the FIFA Women's World Cup in July 2027, so rooms may sell out quickly.

Visa info

  • Citizens of the EU and Portugal don't need a visa for Brazil.
  • US citizens need a simple online visa. Apply here.

Moving around in Rio

We strongly advise against renting a car. Driving in Rio is challenging and traffic can be very aggressive.

Taxis and Uber are inexpensive here, so we recommend Uber Comfort, Uber Black or the TAXI.RIO app. We don't recommend UberX, as its service in Rio isn't very good.

Traveling with little ones

Ubers and taxis don't come with car seats, so bring a portable one or rent one to take with you in the car.

For a car seat, stroller (carrinho) or really anything else for your baby, we recommend AlugaMania in Barra da Tijuca. Most items rent for 30 days, and you can book through their WhatsApp.

A little note about gifts

We don't have our forever home just yet, so we don't have a traditional gift list. For the next couple of years, home will be Stockholm, before we eventually settle down in the US.

So, if you'd like to give us something, we would love for you to contribute toward our future home and life together instead. We've put together a fun little list below. Every gift will become a little part of the home and life we're building, wherever we end up unpacking the boxes.
